name: RT Delete Duplicate Products for WooCommerce
author: raintech357

sections.description:
RT Delete Duplicate Products for WooCommerce helps you find and remove duplicate products from your WooCommerce store quickly and safely. If your product catalogue has grown messy from repeated CSV imports, API syncs, plugin migrations, or copy-paste mistakes, this tool scans your entire catalogue, groups the duplicate products together, and lets you clean them up in bulk — all from a simple, modern screen inside your WordPress dashboard.

No manual searching through hundreds of products. No guessing which listing to keep. Just scan, review, and clean up.

Why Duplicate Products Are a Problem

  • Duplicate content hurts SEO. Two identical product pages compete against each other in Google search results, splitting your ranking power instead of building it.
  • Duplicates confuse shoppers. Customers may land on an outdated duplicate with the wrong price or stock level, costing you sales and trust.
  • Duplicates slow down your store. Every extra product record adds to your database size, which can slow down your WordPress admin and product searches over time.

Cleaning up duplicate WooCommerce products is one of the simplest ways to improve store performance and search visibility — and this plugin makes it fast.

Key Features

Multiple Ways to Find Duplicate Products

  • By Title — finds products and product variations that share the exact same name.
  • By SKU — finds products sharing the same SKU, so you catch duplicates even if the titles were edited.
  • By Both — scans by title and SKU together and merges the results into one list, so nothing slips through.

Clear, Grouped Results

Every set of duplicates is shown as its own group, with each product’s name, SKU, price, stock status, creation date, and quick links to edit or view it — everything you need to decide what to keep, without leaving the page.

Bulk Cleanup, Your Way

Select individual products, an entire group, or products across multiple groups at once. Delete them all together and get a clear summary of how many were removed.

Keep One, Delete the Rest

For any group of duplicates, pick the one product you want to keep and let the plugin queue the rest for removal automatically — the fastest way to resolve a duplicate group.

Built-In Safety Guard

Nothing is deleted without confirmation. A safety dialog always appears before a bulk deletion goes through, so accidental clicks can’t wipe out products.

Handles Variable Products Correctly

When a variable product is removed, its product variations are cleaned up too, so you’re never left with orphaned variation data cluttering your store.

Fast, Modern Admin Experience

The scanner runs inside your WordPress dashboard with no page reloads, so scanning and cleaning up duplicates feels instant.

Who Should Use This Plugin?

  • Store owners who’ve run product imports more than once and ended up with duplicate listings.
  • Agencies and developers migrating a store from another platform who need to clean up the imported catalogue.
  • SEO-focused merchants who want a clean, duplicate-free catalogue so every product page can rank on its own.
  • Anyone whose WooCommerce admin feels slower than it should because of a bloated product list.

How It Works

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Delete Duplicates in your WordPress admin.
  2. Choose how to detect duplicates: Title, SKU, or Both.
  3. Click Scan for Duplicates to see your results, grouped and ready to review.
  4. Compare the products in each group — name, SKU, price, stock, and creation date are all shown.
  5. Select what to remove — one product, a whole group, or across every group at once.
  6. Confirm the deletion and get an instant summary of what was cleaned up.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  3. Search for RT Delete Duplicate Products for WooCommerce.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip and click Install Now.
  4. After installation, click Activate Plugin.

After Activation

  1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active — the plugin will let you know if it isn’t.
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce → Delete Duplicates.
  3. Choose a detection method and scan your catalogue.
sections.faq:
How do I find duplicate products in WooCommerce?

Install this plugin, go to WooCommerce → Delete Duplicates, choose a detection method (Title, SKU, or Both), and click Scan. Duplicate products are grouped together for easy review.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active. If it isn’t, the plugin will let you know and won’t run.

What’s the difference between the Title, SKU, and Both detection methods?

Title finds products with the exact same name. SKU finds products sharing the same SKU value, even if the titles differ. Both runs both scans at once and combines the results, so you catch every duplicate no matter how it happened.

Does it handle variable products and variations?

Yes. Deleting a variable product also removes its variations, so you don’t end up with leftover, orphaned variation data.

Are deletions permanent? Can I undo them?

Deletions are permanent by default, and a confirmation dialog always appears first. We recommend backing up your store before running a large cleanup.

What information can I see for each duplicate product?

Name, SKU, price, stock status, creation date, and quick links to edit the product or view it on the frontend — enough to compare duplicates side-by-side.

Can I keep one product and delete the rest of a group automatically?

Yes. Use Keep One, Delete the Rest to pick which product to keep in a group; everything else in that group is queued for removal.

Who can access the Delete Duplicates page?

Only users who can manage WooCommerce (typically Administrators and Shop Managers).

Will scanning slow down my store?

No. Scans only run when you click the Scan button — they never run automatically or affect your storefront’s performance.

Does this plugin work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, it works on Multisite when activated on each site individually.
sections.changelog:
3.3.0

  • Introduced Pro features: category/tag/attribute filters and the auto-select keep rule.
  • Added an upgrade link in the admin screen and on the Plugins page.

3.2.0

  • Added category, tag, and product-attribute filters to the scanner.
  • Added Settings and Support links on the Plugins page.
  • Advanced Options are now shown above the Scan button, open by default.

3.1.0

  • Added an Advanced Options panel.
  • Choose which product statuses to scan (published, draft, pending, private).
  • Added an auto-select keep rule: keep oldest, newest, highest price, or highest stock.
  • Choose between moving duplicates to Trash or deleting them permanently.

3.0.0

  • Major rebuild: faster scanning, a redesigned admin interface, and full support for variable products and variations.
  • Added the “Keep One, Delete the Rest” workflow.
  • Product details expanded to include price, stock status, creation date, and quick links.
  • Full translation-readiness and right-to-left language support.

1.0.0

  • Initial release — duplicate detection by title, bulk deletion, and a confirmation dialog.
